task.problem: Real downstream Python Agent TASK-125 exposed a reproducible kernel-boundary failure. RUN-125-008 and RUN-125-009 both produced clean committed CODE_FIX repair deltas inside the authorized narrow scope, but failed at COMPLETION_GATE with RESULT.changed_files mismatch. The current REPAIR completion policy requires Result.changed_files to equal git diff from the original TASK root_base_sha to the final HEAD, while REPAIR mutation authority is separately checked from the failed HEAD to final HEAD. Native repair executors therefore have to infer and redeclare a full historical TASK file set unrelated to the narrow correction they just made. That duplicates deterministic Runtime knowledge and makes a correct committed repair fail because probabilistic structural output disagrees with repository truth. Runtime already owns both Git comparisons and must become the sole authority for canonical REPAIR changed_files.
